title: Designation for cores and assemblies for transformers and inductors for used in telecommunication and electronic equipment, Part 1: Laminated cores
clause_1_scope: This standard ( Part 1 ) specifies designation code for cores and assemblies for transformers and inductors made from laminations. IS No. Title General requirements and tests

clause_2_normative_references.title: Equipment for eye and face protection during welding

clause_3_terminology: Designation for cores and assemblies for transformers and inductors for used in telecommunication and electronic equipment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
